title: Israel Multiplies and is Enslaved

questions.question: Who went down to Egypt with his family, numbering seventy persons?
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:1, 5 (ESV): "These are the names of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt with Jacob… All the descendants of Jacob were seventy persons."

questions.question: What happened to the Israelites in Egypt over time?
options: They multiplied and grew exceedingly strong
questions.correctAnswer: They multiplied and grew exceedingly strong
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:7 (ESV): "But the people of Israel were fruitful and increased greatly; they multiplied and grew exceedingly strong."

questions.question: What did Pharaoh command the Hebrew midwives to do?
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:16 (ESV): "When you serve as midwife to the Hebrew women… if it is a son, you shall kill him."

questions.question: What were the names of the two Hebrew midwives?
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:15 (ESV): "Then the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, one of whom was named Shiphrah and the other Puah."

questions.question: Did the midwives obey Pharaoh's command to kill the baby boys?
options: No, they feared God and let the boys live
questions.correctAnswer: No, they feared God and let the boys live
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:17 (ESV): "But the midwives feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them, but let the male children live."

questions.question: Why did the new king of Egypt oppress the Israelites?
options: He feared their numbers and potential rebellion
He needed their land for farming
He wanted their wealth and possessions
questions.correctAnswer: He feared their numbers and potential rebellion
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:9-10 (ESV): "Behold, the people of Israel are too many and too mighty for us. Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, lest they multiply."

questions.question: What cities did the Israelites build for Pharaoh as store cities?
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:11 (ESV): "Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with heavy burdens. They built for Pharaoh store cities, Pithom and Raamses."

questions.question: What happened the more the Egyptians oppressed the Israelites?
options: They multiplied and spread even more
questions.correctAnswer: They multiplied and spread even more
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:12 (ESV): "But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and the more they spread abroad."

questions.question: What excuse did the midwives give Pharaoh for not killing the Hebrew boys?
options: They said they could not find the babies
They said Hebrew women gave birth before they arrived
They said they refused on religious grounds
They said the Egyptian guards stopped them
questions.correctAnswer: They said Hebrew women gave birth before they arrived
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:19 (ESV): "The midwives said to Pharaoh, 'Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.'"

questions.question: How did God reward the midwives for their faithfulness?
options: He gave them gold and silver
He gave them families of their own
He took them out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: He gave them families of their own
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:21 (ESV): "And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families."

questions.question: According to Exodus 1:8, what significant fact did the new king not know?
options: He did not know about the plagues
He did not know the God of Israel
He did not know about the covenant with Abraham
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:8 (ESV): "Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph."

questions.question: What type of work made the Egyptians ruthless toward the Israelites?
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:14 (ESV): "And made their lives bitter with hard service, in mortar and brick, and in all kinds of work in the field."

questions.question: What was Pharaoh's final command when the midwives failed to kill the Hebrew boys?
options: To throw every son born into the Nile
To exile the Hebrews to the desert
questions.correctAnswer: To throw every son born into the Nile
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:22 (ESV): "Then Pharaoh commanded all his people, 'Every son that is born to the Hebrews you shall cast into the Nile.'"

questions.question: What emotion did the Egyptians feel toward the Israelites according to Exodus 1:12?
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:12 (ESV): "But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied... And the Egyptians were in dread of the people of Israel."

questions.question: Which son of Jacob is specifically mentioned as coming to Egypt in Exodus 1?
options: Eleven sons, as Joseph was already there
questions.correctAnswer: Eleven sons, as Joseph was already there
questions.explanation: Exodus 1:1-5 lists the sons who came TO Egypt with Jacob; Joseph was already there (v.5 notes "Joseph was already in Egypt").

key_verse_text: But the people of Israel were fruitful and increased greatly; they multiplied and grew exceedingly strong, so that the land was filled with them.
